ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: 'channels:watched' Mark all channels as watched (Touchpad on Subscribed channels) and 'Mark channel as watched' in a channel's menu; g_channel_marks keeps the newest video seen for each profile
items.notes: The mark is cleared locally on this PS5: the pinned library has no call for it (docs/LIBRARY_SERVICE.md).

items.title: Check for updates (section menu)
items.smarttube: Section menu entry that starts the app update check.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: 'Check for updates' (settings:update:check) is the last row of a main-menu section's menu (settings:section:<n>, Touchpad on its row), listed when the updater is part of the build; native/tube_update_app.c
tests/test_update_provider.c (scripts/test_update.sh): the row is absent without the updater, last in the section menu with it, and nothing is asked until it is selected
items.notes: The answer is listed in About. Offline evidence only: never run on a console or against GitHub (docs/UPDATES.md).

items.title: Text search with paged results
items.smarttube: Submitting a query loads result groups; scrolling continues them; cards have the normal click / long-press behaviour.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: search() / catalog() action 'search' with page

Built-in service: standalone/js/catalog.js (pageFor: search, channel and playlist pages with their playback contexts, links and the video: / channel: / playlist: forms) over the bundled library modules; standalone/test/service_test.py ('search page shape', 'search by link', 'channel catalog', 'playlist catalog'), tests/test_embedded_e2e.c (scripts/test_embedded_e2e.sh)
items.notes: Also accepts YouTube URLs and video:/channel:/playlist: forms.

items.title: Typing / commit behaviour
items.smarttube: Custom search bar: tags update while typing, results load on submit or tag click; options for keyboard auto-show, autofocus on results, typing corrections.
ps5_evidence: scripts/prepare_native.py: evo_keyboard_open("Search YouTube videos...") (PS5 system keyboard, search on confirm)
gaps: The query is not kept editable on a search screen: no visible search field to refine, and nothing happens while typing
No re-run of the last query without retyping
items.notes: Keyboard-related options (auto show, G20s fix, corrections) are Android-specific.

items.title: Search suggestions / autocomplete (incl. popular searches)
items.smarttube: Search tags provider returns completions for the typed text and popular/recent queries when empty; clicking a tag searches.
ps5_evidence: Built-in service: search_suggestions of the bundled library modules; search suggestions checked live as Guest on 2026-10-11 (standalone/README.md)
gaps: No as-you-type list while the keyboard is open

items.title: Search history
items.smarttube: Recent queries shown as tags; long-press removes one or clears all; setting to disable history.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: Recent searches folder and per-profile switch; tests/test_search_history.c
items.notes: Fits the per-profile JSON state and local_catalog() folders.

items.title: Voice search
items.smarttube: Voice recognition fills the query and searches; optional instant voice search on opening search.
gaps: Not available with the built-in service (the release): no speech recognizer on the console; L3 and its help line are hidden. Works only with the external development companion (docs/VOICE_SEARCH.md, 'Without a companion')
No instant voice search on opening search
items.notes: Was 'done' while the companion was the service; the release runs without one. Physical microphone acceptance is still open. With a phone linked, the YouTube app's own voice search works from the phone.
